intent.proves: Assortments: anonymous-range satisfies the selected profile assertion.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomAssortments a WHERE a.AssortmentActive = 1 AND a.AssortmentAllowAnonymousUsers = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomAssortmentItems i WHERE i.AssortmentItemAssortmentID = a.AssortmentID)
